rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>During the stalemate, a single shot I fired

rows.notes: Closes the Mission 10B Rutil/L System arc; rows 4332+ (resource 6131) belong to a different, unrelated scene and are out of range.

uncertainties.note: Speaker of 'I won't hand over the L System' is not settled by adjacent rows; could be Jamil (echoing his earlier refusal at 4212) or one of the Frost brothers demanding it be kept from the New Federation. Left subjectless.
L System spelled without a hyphen, continuing the choice made in batch_04202.json; flagged there for centralized confirmation against character_names_021.json's hyphenated form.
Source text has a likely typo (ureshikatta written without its shi syllable); translated as the evidently intended 'was happy' given the scene's farewell tone, not literally.
'that boy' (ano shounen) addressed to Jamil alongside Tiffa is not identified in this row range; no name supplied for an unconfirmed referent.

'Federation side' (renpou-gawa) kept distinct from the locked 'New Federation' (book(38)/shinrenpou): this line describes the historical government from 15 years before the New Federation's rise, per encyclopedia_022.json's GX-9900 entry ('fielded as the Earth side's decisive weapon ... 7th Space War').

Group vow scene: speakers are inferable from established pairings (Garrod/Tiffa, Renton/Eureka, Faye/Barrel) but names are not inserted into the lines themselves, matching source, which identifies only the protected party via color tags.
